inspiration: Three death kinds (regular, unfair, blessed), each with its own text and window size, and the cost shown as a number (modules/game_playerdeath/playerdeath.lua:3-7, 51-65; penalty shown at line 57). Keep the tiers and the numbers; our own tiers and words.

The death window offers two choices: one re-enters the world, the other leaves safely, with Enter and Escape bound to them (playerdeath.lua:70-85). A respawn-or-leave choice gives the player control at the worst moment.
A single death notice: the 'You are dead' line is skipped when the centre label is visible (playerdeath.lua:35-40, guard at line 37). One source of truth stops two notices stacking.

A radial or linear sweep on each skill icon: the fill step is 10000 divided by the duration, scheduled again 100 ms later (modules/game_cooldown/cooldown.lua:149-162, scheduling at lines 155-158). Good readability for short cooldowns, but see the tick defect below.
A shared bar per spell group: one bar and one icon stand for a whole group of skills (cooldown.lua:203-224). Useful when several attacks share a recovery.
A small status badge set: 17 state icons, 18 x 18 px, one per status effect (data/images/game/states/). Badges readable at 375 px.

A rarity frame strip: a 160 x 32 px strip with white and blue 32 x 32 pieces next to it (data/images/ui/rarity_frames.png; rarity_white.png; rarity_blue.png). Five 32 px cells is an inference from the size, not verified in code.
Named sound cues per combat event: eight OGG cues, including low health and low mana, attack and detection (data/sounds/). Each cue is an event name, so the map from event to sound is easy to edit.
Layout overrides: a layout replaces any file in data/ with the same path (layouts/README.md:1). A mobile set of 6 files and a retro set of 114 files show a small override for touch use.

defects.defect: progressRect.icon = icon runs before the check 'if progressRect then', so a missing bar errors on that line
defects.fix: move the assignment inside the if block; keep the group bar idea

defects.defect: fixed 100 ms step regardless of duration, so short cooldowns look jumpy
defects.fix: advance by frame time and clamp the fill to 100; keep the sweep idea

briefs.label: 18 px state badge
briefs.why: A small badge per status effect, readable at 375 px, lets the player read what is on them without text. The badge is the signature; the colour and the outline make it striking.
keep: one badge per status effect, 18 px
a small set of badges (17 here)
badges sit on the portrait or bar
change: silhouettes from our own status list, not these icons
a border colour per family (harm, aid, control)
badge pulses once on apply, not on every tick

briefs.label: three-tier death screen
briefs.why: Three kinds of death, each with a different tone and the cost shown in numbers, make a loss feel explained rather than random. Keeps the death readable.
keep: cost shown as a number in the window
two choices, re-enter or leave safe
change: our own tier names and text
cost shown as a bar, not a sentence
respawn point shown on the window

briefs.label: shared group cooldown bar
briefs.why: One bar for a whole group of attacks tells the player the recovery is shared. Simple at 375 px and a clear read.
keep: one bar stands for a group
the group bar is separate from single-skill bars
the bar fills on the same sweep
change: group is a weapon family, not a spell group
bar sits under the attack buttons, not in a side panel
fill uses frame time, not a 100 ms step

briefs.label: rarity frame strip
briefs.why: A frame strip with one cell per rarity gives loot a colour and border read without text. Shows how one strip can serve every rarity.
keep: one strip with a cell per rarity
a frame around the item icon
frame size matches the icon cell
change: our own rarity count and colour ramp
frame with a different corner ornament
